definition_hash_policy: SHA256 of canonical UTF8 JSON: sorted keys, compact separators, final LF; every format or validator-policy change, including additive changes, requires a new hash

primitives.binary64: IEEE754 little-endian exact bit pattern; finite; dimensions nonnegative
primitives.optional: presence boolean then payload iff present
primitives.str: u32 byte length then canonical scalar UTF8 excluding NUL; <=2048 UTF16 units and <=6144 bytes; no trimming

status: unregistered source candidate; provider operation, capability, minor and header PIN unassigned

validator_policy.actions: reserved-zero nested correlation; complete strict decode and owned input copy before effects; expected identity matches Query; nonzero node/option/lease, valid range direction,start<=end<=2048 and bounded text; lease-bound native baseline and authority checked by Session
validator_policy.body: empty actual/visibility-pruned forest valid iff metadata/forms empty, active_node0, no selection; truncated empty allowed with explicit truncated/degradation state; never synthesize root. Nonempty actual element-rooted native preorder forest, unique nonzero IDs, already-published element parent on live ancestry, depth<=256; projected direct child count<=actual count; total actual child counts<=8192; text nodes have text only and zero element flags/child count
validator_policy.completion: action correlation with reserved-zero nested document request ID; accepted requires code ok and full actual paired publication; effects_entered with rejected forbidden, use unknown; popup requires effects; retained completion retries never replay action
validator_policy.consumer_gate: reject epoch>UINT32_MAX, editor revision>INT32_MAX, publication or lease-captured revision/node/control/option/nested document_request_id>2^53-1; generation, opaque lease IDs and outer sequence remain exact native64; no remap/truncation/JSNumber rounding
validator_policy.editor: revision nonzero; flags known0..31; active_node0 or emitted element including masked/omitted focus marker; focused control matches active_node; inputMethodEnabled from required authoritative actual EditorClient accessor; missing/unavailable rejects native publication
validator_policy.form_join: controls in body order with emitted element same ID, matching native type/tag, disabled and omitted; input types on input except button/reset/submit input or button, textarea/fieldset/object/output corresponding tag, select-one/multiple on select; secure type may be text for obscured autofill; body text/href empty, name=label, value=canonical FormTextState value or empty
validator_policy.forms_reuse: direct foundation::appended::validate_document_forms with default FormLimits, including native type/kind, state, selection scalar boundaries, per-kind caps, lease identity, unique control/option IDs, global text/options, focused<=1
validator_policy.identity: every identity/version/outer_sequence nonzero; Version generation equals Identity application_instance and epoch equals service_generation; body/forms exact Version; reply/completion exact request Identity
validator_policy.metadata: unique emitted element IDs in body order; at most one row per element; tags and role/display/white_space share metadata pool
validator_policy.omission: omitted nonsecure descriptor unsupported+monostate, label empty and caps=0; secure descriptor may also be omitted; no private hidden baseline reads
validator_policy.options_join: native option IDs may be absent body; if present must option element with owning select as nearest select ancestor, in native order with matching disabled/omitted and no mask; omitted option label empty and owner incomplete,caps=0,no lease
validator_policy.redaction: masked/omitted body fields text/name/value/href empty, editable=false, metadata strings empty, descendants absent; masked iff secure_readonly descriptor on input; no secure value length/attributes/label/selection/descendants getter reads; native capture must establish nonreads
validator_policy.reply_admission: allocation-free fixed prefix exact-identity plus per-kind correlation admission (query nested nonzero, action nested reserved zero) does not replace complete action decode; allocate1MiB ReplyReservation before effects; retained encoded bytes immutable, same-byte retry allowed, conflicting replacement rejects
validator_policy.request_sequence_domains: query/reply document_request_id nonzero, distinct full64 from outer_sequence; action/completion document_request_id reserved ZERO because form actions have no DocumentController request token; full action completion publication is not a DocumentSemanticReply and never fabricates a token
validator_policy.selection: published unmasked/unomitted endpoints with exact kind; text offsets actual UTF16 scalar boundaries, element offsets<=actual_native_child_count; finite Rect with nonnegative dimensions; selection_unavailable degradation forbids Selection
validator_policy.strict_decode: reject unknown headers/enums/flags, noncanonical booleans/UTF8, NUL, invalid lengths/counts, trailing bytes; check byte/count bounds before allocation and UTF16 pool charges while decoding
validator_policy.transaction: nonwrapping burned counter reservations; checked subtraction budgets; unforgeable move-only immutable PreparedPublication from validate+encode before no-throw consumed-token commit; failed preparation leaves prior slot unchanged; empty token commit no-op; native Session shares same final commit phase
validator_policy.truncated: no selection and every control caps=0,no lease; retain only complete paired marker descriptors or explicit incomplete capability-free descriptors
